## Wave 7 Summary

Wave 7 resolves the two open emergent-geometry questions left by S93's spectral-dimension and LQG narrow-path waves. Both are substrate-IS observables on the spectral triple `(A_K, H_K, D_K)` read through cross-framework bridge maps; the wave's discipline is the SAME-functional fair-comparison rule (`phononic-framing.md §"Same-functional-different-scale fair-comparison"` + `cross-pillar-bridge-anatomy.md §"Diffusion-window-observable specialization"`).

- **Item 22 (`S94-DS-GAMMA-E-RESOLUTION`)** discharges the W7-3 INDETERMINATE γ_E. The W7-3 kk × landau workshop (`s93-w7-3-gamma-e-dos-exponent-estimator.md`, CONVERGED) refuted all three prior fixed-τ prescriptions: the DOS estimator is not the fix (both `Σ m_i` and `Σ 1` shadows are corrupted — center-CHAOTIC and out-of-[0,1] respectively), the fixed-τ band contest cannot resolve it (γ_E is L_max-saturated + double-sided rep-starved), and `Z_B2(τ)→0` is wrong (Z=ρ·v_g=1/π is the n-INVARIANT product). The discriminator is relocated OFF the fixed-τ slice onto the SCALAR group-velocity trajectory `v_g^{B2}(τ)` — ONE number per τ across ≥7 τ-slices spanning τ_fold=0.19, from the L_max=12 master D_K cache re-evaluated per τ. This is a REAL eigenvalue compute. The kk-vs-landau pair execute it adversarially (kk → Reading-KK n=2 √-edge; landau → Reading-van-Hove infinite-order vH). Discharges S34 [F-4].

- **Item 23 (`S94-NARROW-PATH-WORKSHOP-6-COCYCLE`)** builds the explicit Reading-(b) Hochschild cocycle `[S_exit-horizon]^♯` at the τ~0.16 acoustic-white-hole exit-horizon 2-surface (S70 Six-Layer Causal Structure), computes the α_bridge OOM under the declared DL/Meissner SU(2) state-counting + the refined j≤3 area-volume band, and selects Regime I vs Regime II. It is a Step-4 cocycle-construction workshop-dispatch gate. The (0,0)-singlet question is RETIRED-BENIGN (S93 connes adjudication: area operator sums over j≥1/2 punctures). The §(iv-bis) discipline is load-bearing: the `|α_bridge|≥s_CS/N_e` floor is an ANSATZ surrogate (the 6.38e-3 value is a Regime-II INDICATOR, NOT a registry-eligible floor); only the trivial `≥0` is sign-lock-free.

  the spectral-dimension fold question is resolved at the band-dispersion layer, NOT the corrupted
  fixed-τ γ_E estimators. The selected reading fixes γ_E's true value for downstream consumers.
FAIL_meaning: >
  v_g^{B2}(τ) is non-monotone / inconsistent across the grid such that neither reading is selected,
  OR the leading-order fit is itself ill-conditioned (the band-dispersion probe ALSO fails to
  discriminate). This would mean the geometric discriminator is corrupted too, closing the
  band-dispersion corridor and forcing the question back to a full-SU(3) σ-model treatment (the
  upstream-deferred 7th-branch route). A FAIL maps S34 [F-4] as structurally undecidable on the
  L_max=12 cache.
INFO_meaning: >
  A reading is favored but not decisive: e.g. v_g^{B2}(τ_fold) lands in a transition band
  (v_g_floor ≤ |v_g^{B2}(τ_fold)| ≤ 10·v_g_floor) so n_dispersion is between 1 and 2 (a soft √-edge

  Per the S87 schema-v2 composite-collapse rule, an INFO here is the magnitude_verdict=INFO branch.

  type: "set"     # regime-selection predicate set over the jointly-constrained α_bridge OOM
  form: >
    Let α_bridge be the OOM extracted from the joint cocycle/Bogoliubov/Cauchy-Schwarz constraints
    under DL/Meissner + j≤3. Regime I (PASS-Regime-I): α_bridge ∈ [10^{-3.3}, 10^{-2.7}] (matches
    γ_BH=0.2375 within 30% via α_bridge=γ_BH/49.34=4.81e-3). Regime II (PASS-Regime-II / substrate-
    structural): α_bridge ∈ [10^{-1}, 10^{1}] (γ_emergent~50, ~200× mismatch; no γ cutoff-running
    recovery per Paper 03 §VII). Regime III (INFO): α_bridge (p,q)-dependent.

# (2) strict_PASS_boundary
strict_PASS_boundary:
  value: >
    Regime-I band: |log10(α_bridge) − log10(4.81e-3)| ≤ 0.30 OOM (i.e. α_bridge ∈ [10^{-3.3},10^{-2.7}],
    matches γ_BH within 30%). Regime-II band: log10(α_bridge) ∈ [−1, 1]. The gate's TOP-LINE verdict is
    "workshop CONVERGES" = a single regime is selected by the joint constraints with the cocycle
    constructed (non-trivial in HH^•) and all three structural constraints simultaneously satisfiable.
  direction: "<="   # Regime-I PASS via OOM-distance ≤ 0.30; Regime-II via band membership

# (3) boundary_reachable_analytically
boundary_reachable_analytically:
  bool: true
  proof_ref: >
    The required α_bridge≈4.81e-3 = γ_BH/49.34 (ALPHA_BRIDGE_REQUIRED_FW, S92 L2 substitution chain).
    The pre/post lock R_BG=1/cosh(2r) (W8-6 PASS; α_bridge^post = W_BG·α_bridge^pre, W_BG=cosh(2r)=1462.30
    from S38 n_Bog=0.99863). The Cauchy-Schwarz floor F_0·F_2≥F_1² is a substrate-IS spectral-triple
    identity (KO-dim-independent). NOTE §(iv-bis): the floor surrogate |α_bridge| ≥ s_CS/N_e (s_CS=0.0186,
    giving α_win_lo=6.381e-3) is an ANSATZ, NOT a derived identity — only the trivial ≥0 is sign-lock-free.
    See substitution_chain Claim C below for the surrogate-vs-canonical disclosure.

# (7) substitution_chain  — MANDATORY (α_bridge OOM vs canonical pin + the ANSATZ-surrogate disclosure)
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim A (regime selection): "α_bridge ~ O(1) ⇒ Regime II; α_bridge ≈ 4.81e-3 ⇒ Regime I."
    Step 1: α_bridge := the dimensionless coefficient in the Level-2 envelope
            ‖R_narrow-path^{(L_max)} − α_bridge·M_KK^{-2}·√(C_2(p,q))‖ → 0 as L_max→∞.   [registry Element 4]
    Step 2: Regime-I closure requires γ_emergent = γ_BH = 0.2375 (SU(2) convention).   [GAMMA_BH_SU2_CONVENTION_LQG]
    Step 3: ALPHA_BRIDGE_REQUIRED_FW = γ_BH / 49.34 = 0.2375 / 49.34 = 4.81e-3.   [S92 L2 chain; canonical pin]
    Step 4: substrate-side prior anchor N_e = 2.92 (post-fold acoustic e-folds; the only landed
            bulk-to-surface reduction at landing magnitude) ⇒ substrate produces O(1) outputs, not
            10^{-3}-suppressed ⇒ P(Regime II) ≥ 0.6.   [registry §"Substrate-likely outcome"]
    Step 5: read-off: if the joint-constrained α_bridge OOM lands within 0.30 dex of 4.81e-3 ⇒ Regime I
            (narrow path closes); if it lands in [10^{-1},10^1] ⇒ Regime II (γ_emergent~50, ~200×;
            no recovery — γ admits no cutoff-running per Paper 03 §VII).
    Conclusion: the gate SELECTS the regime from the constructed cocycle's α_bridge OOM; the substrate
            prior favors Regime II but the workshop's cocycle construction is the decisive evidence.

    Claim B (pre/post lock — NOT a free parameter): "α_bridge^post = W_BG · α_bridge^pre, W_BG=cosh(2r)=1462.30."
    Step 1: R_BG := α_bridge^pre / α_bridge^post = 1/cosh(2r) (W8-6 PASS, narrow-path pre/post bridge-coeff ratio).
    Step 2: from S38 n_Bog=0.99863 = tanh²r ⇒ cosh(2r)=|u|²+|v|² = 1462.30 ⇒ W_BG=1462.30, R_BG=6.84e-4.
    Step 3: substitute ⇒ α_bridge^post = 1462.30 · α_bridge^pre (post-fold coefficient LARGER by W_BG).   [Class-(b) cross-pillar forward-extension; sign DERIVED, W_BG>1 alignment-independent]
    Conclusion: the pre/post relation is LOCKED, not free; the regime selection applies to the
            consistently-chosen incarnation (declare pre or post in the verdict value).

    Claim C (§(iv-bis) ANSATZ-surrogate disclosure — REQUIRED): "the 6.38e-3 floor is a Regime-II INDICATOR, NOT a registry-eligible floor."
    Step 1: the proxy bound |α_bridge| ≥ s_CS/N_e (s_CS=0.0186, N_e=2.92) gives α_win_lo = 0.0186/2.92 = 6.381e-3.
    Step 2: this is an ANSATZ (a surrogate-for-a-magnitude-bound per substrate-first-canonical-sourcing §(iv-bis)),
            NOT a derived identity. The sign/magnitude is NOT mechanically locked to a substrate combinatorial
            fraction in a sign-lock-free way — only the trivial |α_bridge| ≥ 0 is sign-lock-free-derived.
    Step 3: therefore citing 6.38e-3 as a "substrate-derived floor" (tag (a)) is a Class-(f) PIN-PLACEHOLDER
            risk; the correct tag is (b) "prescription-independent Regime-II INDICATOR." The flip threshold
            N_e* = 3.871 > 2.92 (all ledger N_e) over-determines the Regime-II LEAN, but the LEAN ≠ a
            registry-eligible numerical floor.
    Conclusion: the gate may USE 6.38e-3 as a Regime-II indicator in the regime-selection narrative, but
            MUST NOT land it as a registry-eligible Level-3 floor anchor. A genuine Level-3 anchor requires
            the constructed cocycle's α_bridge OOM (deliverable 1+2), not the surrogate bound.

# ---- Verdict rubric ----
PASS_meaning: >
  The workshop CONVERGES: the explicit cocycle [S_exit-horizon]^♯ is constructed and non-trivial in
  HH^•(A_K) (Level-1 extraction), AND a single α_bridge OOM is jointly consistent with all three
  structural constraints (cocycle-existence ∧ Bogoliubov-covariance ∧ Cauchy-Schwarz-floor) under
  DL/Meissner SU(2) + j≤3, AND a regime is selected. PASS-Regime-I (α_bridge within 0.30 dex of
  4.81e-3): the narrow path constructively closes; γ_emergent matches γ_BH; lqg-narrow-path-bridge-class
  promotes REGISTRY-INCOMPLETE-PENDING-FIRST-EXTRACTION → STAGE-1-CANDIDATE with the Level-3 anchor
  landed. PASS-Regime-II (α_bridge ∈ [10^{-1},10^1]): the substrate's OWN kinematical-layer effective
  geometry is characterized (γ_emergent~50, ~200× mismatch, no recovery); the narrow path to canonical
  LQG does NOT close, and the bridge-class entry is re-scoped to the substrate-novel effective theory.
  Either way the cocycle existence + regime selection is the structural deliverable.
FAIL_meaning: >
  The workshop does NOT converge: the three structural constraints are MUTUALLY INCOMPATIBLE (no
  α_bridge OOM simultaneously satisfies cocycle-existence ∧ Bogoliubov-covariance ∧ Cauchy-Schwarz-floor),
  OR the cocycle [S_exit-horizon]^♯ is EXACT (trivial in HH^•(A_K)) so Reading-(b) collapses and the
  Step-4 projection has no Hochschild representative. A FAIL maps the Reading-(b) corridor as closed:
  the §IX.7 narrow path would then have NO structurally-honest Step-4 reading on the L_max=12 cache,
  routing back to a Step-4 re-derivation (the upstream-deferred full-σ-model route).
INFO_meaning: >
  The cocycle is constructed but the α_bridge OOM is not pinned to a single regime under the available
  prescription (e.g. DL/Meissner SU(2) leaves a residual prescription-ambiguity, or the j≤3 band spans
  a Regime-I/Regime-II boundary). INFO records the cocycle existence + the regime LEAN (Regime-II-favoring
  per the N_e=2.92 prior + the over-determined flip threshold N_e*=3.871) WITHOUT crystallizing the
  Level-3 anchor — the bridge-class entry stays REGISTRY-INCOMPLETE with the cocycle now extracted (Level-1
  PENDING-FIRST-EXTRACTION → Level-1 EXTRACTED, Level-3 still pending). This is the documented W8-3-INFO-
  keyed deferral pattern carried forward; the 6.38e-3 surrogate is cited ONLY as a Regime-II indicator
  (tag (b)), never as a registry-eligible floor.

## Wave 7 → Wave 8 Decision Point

Wave 8 (`volovik-superfluid-universe-theorist`: §VII.AV Stage-2 re-verify + §VII.AR PASS-A substrate-derivation) does NOT consume Wave 7 outputs — the two waves are independent. Wave 7's own internal decision points:

- **Item 22 → downstream**: PASS (Reading-KK selected) ⇒ γ_E≈1/2 is the framework value; the windowed-d_s Hawking relation `n_s−1 ~ −d(d_s)/dτ` (Open-Question-2, vs −0.0433) is addressed by the SECONDARY d_s(σ_*;τ) τ-flow IF a nonzero flow appears (subordinate diagnostic, NOT the primary read). PASS (Reading-van-Hove selected) ⇒ γ_E→1 (infinite-order vH); the spectral-dimension fold reduction is the flat-band bottleneck. FAIL ⇒ the band-dispersion corridor closes; S34 [F-4] is structurally undecidable on the L_max=12 cache and routes to a full-SU(3) σ-model carry-forward (S95). INFO ⇒ the reading LEAN is recorded; γ_E is not crystallized; a finer τ-grid / higher-L_max carry-forward is queued.
- **Item 23 → downstream**: PASS-Regime-I ⇒ queue the Stage-2 cross-axis verify gate (S95) for the lqg-narrow-path-bridge-class STAGE-1-CANDIDATE. PASS-Regime-II ⇒ re-scope the bridge-class entry to the substrate-novel effective theory; queue the substrate-OWN narrow-path effective-geometry characterization (S95). INFO ⇒ cocycle extracted, regime LEAN recorded (Regime-II-favoring), Level-3 still pending; queue a refined-prescription α_bridge gate (S95). FAIL ⇒ Reading-(b) corridor closed; queue a Step-4 re-derivation.

Each downstream item is a genuine future computation (4-field carry-forward at wave-synthesis per `feedback_fix-in-session-never-defer.md`), NOT an in-session deferral.
